impl_requirements: Emit a complete .metal file with one or more kernel functions. Kernels must use the canonical entry signature (device T* inputs/outputs, constant T& params). Do NOT add host-side Objective-C wrappers or main() — the project build system handles host dispatch.
read_metric_guide: Metal on Apple Silicon uses unified memory (UMA), so dram_pct is always null. Focus on sm_pct (GPU core utilization) when available via GPU trace, or use wall-clock timing-only comparisons. Low threadgroup occupancy on Metal often indicates insufficient threads dispatched or register pressure limiting concurrent threadgroups.

vectorized_load_store.idiom: packed_float4 / packed_half4 vectorized global loads and stores
vectorized_load_store.prompt_guidance: Widen memory transactions to 128-bit by using packed_float4 or packed_half4 types so each thread moves 16 bytes per access.

memory_coalescing.idiom: coalesced 128-bit device memory reads with simdgroup-aligned addressing
memory_coalescing.prompt_guidance: Reorder the thread-to-element mapping so consecutive threads in a simdgroup read consecutive addresses in device memory.

shared_memory_tiling.prompt_guidance: Stage reused operands into threadgroup memory via threadgroup T* arrays, sync with threadgroup_barrier(mem_flags::mem_threadgroup), then compute from threadgroup memory to cut redundant device traffic.

l2_cache_reuse.idiom: reuse threadgroup memory across multiple compute stages
l2_cache_reuse.prompt_guidance: Use the same threadgroup allocation for multiple phases of computation rather than allocating separate buffers per phase — keeps reused operands on-chip instead of re-fetching from device memory.

block_size_tuning.idiom: sweep threadgroup size (256/512/1024) for the GPU core count
block_size_tuning.prompt_guidance: Try threadgroup sizes that are multiples of the simdgroup size (32) — 256/512/1024 — to balance threadgroup occupancy against per-thread register resources.

register_pressure_reduction.idiom: scope-narrowing / recompute to reduce per-thread register usage
register_pressure_reduction.prompt_guidance: Shorten variable lifetimes and prefer recompute over caching to keep per-thread register count low — Metal's threadgroup occupancy drops sharply above register limits.

instruction_reduction.idiom: strength reduction and loop unrolling via metal::unroll
instruction_reduction.prompt_guidance: Hoist invariants, replace divides/mods with shifts where legal, and annotate inner loops with [[clang::loop_unroll]] for the Metal compiler.

fast_math_intrinsics.prompt_guidance: Where precision tolerance allows, use metal::fast or precise::fast_math namespaced intrinsics (fast::exp, fast::rsqrt) instead of the precise variants.

register_tiling.idiom: simd_shuffle / simd_shuffle_down for intra-simdgroup register reductions
register_tiling.prompt_guidance: Use simd_shuffle and simd_shuffle_down for warp-level reductions, keeping partial sums in registers instead of threadgroup barriers, avoiding full-group sync overhead.

kernel_fusion.idiom: merge sequential compute encoders into a single kernel with an epilogue
kernel_fusion.prompt_guidance: Avoid multiple MTLComputeCommandEncoder passes by fusing the elementwise epilogue into the producing kernel before the final store — one dispatch instead of two cuts launch/encoder overhead.
